# fmc_device_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Device Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_device_group" "example" {
  name        = "my_device_group"
  description = "My device group"
  members = [
    {
      device_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the device group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the device group.
- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `members` (Attributes Set) Set of devices that belong to this device group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the resource; this value is always 'DeviceGroup'.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Optional:

- `device_id` (String) Id of the device.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_device_group.example "<domain>,<id>"
```
